children.value: The measured pressures are gauge pressures. Because the piezometer is open to the atmosphere, the hydrostatic pressure due to the static column height will be relative to atmospheric.
A piezometer is open to the atmosphere and so is only suitable to measure pressures in liquids and not gasses. A gas would simply escape.

between the pipeline fluid and the atmospheric free surface. This means that a manometer can measure pressures in any fluid - liquid or gas.
